author_claim: Active-listening capabilities improved engagement and elicited response quality.
evidence_statement: The full chatbot significantly outperformed the baseline across agent comprehension, user interest, chat experience, engagement duration, response word count, and manually coded response quality.
reviewer_interpretation: Specific conversational capabilities—not chatbot presence alone—can improve elicitation, although intent models performed unevenly across topics.
measure: user ratings, engagement, word count, and coded response quality
